components.name: Primary Capture Button
components.description: The full-width primary action changes among Start, Stop, and Upload as the capture state changes.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: #176647; color: #fff; font: 650 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #105438; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4d9874; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } }

components.name: Secondary Discard Button
components.description: A quiet, bordered action for discarding the current local capture.
components.css: .ds-discard { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #e1e7e3; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; color: #4d5a52; font: 550 11px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-discard:hover { background: #f5f8f6; color: #202925; } .ds-discard:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4d9874; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Audio Source Switch
components.description: An independently selectable audio source with a visible label and compact switch.
components.css: .ds-source { display: inline-flex; min-height: 36px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: #36433b; font: 400 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-source input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; } .ds-track { display: inline-flex; width: 30px; height: 18px; align-items: center; padding: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: #adb8b1; transition: background-color 140ms ease-out; } .ds-track i { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 18%); transition: transform 140ms ease-out; } .ds-source input:checked + .ds-track { background: #176647; } .ds-source input:checked + .ds-track i { transform: translateX(12px); } .ds-source input:focus-visible + .ds-track { outline: 3px solid #4d9874; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-track, .ds-track i { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } }

components.name: Connection Settings Panel
components.description: An inline, disclosed panel for connection origin and credential fields.
components.css: .ds-settings { padding: 13px 14px 14px; border: 1px solid #e1e7e3; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #202925; font: 400 12px/1.45 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-settings strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-settings label { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: #35413a; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-settings input { height: 34px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid #ccd6d0; border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; color: #202925; font: 400 12px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-settings input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4d9874; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Recording Timer
components.description: The real elapsed capture timer and thin duration track anchor the recording stage.
components.css: .ds-stage { text-align: center; color: #18231d; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-timer { font-size: clamp(56px, 18vw, 72px); font-weight: 450; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.05; } .ds-timer span { color: #87928c; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 450; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-progress { width: min(100%, 300px); height: 3px; overflow: hidden; margin: 12px auto 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #e7ece9; } .ds-progress i { display: block; width: 20%; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: #176647; transform-origin: left; }

narrative.overview:
Savia Companion is a small desktop utility for recording a short sample and choosing when to upload it for review in Savia. Its quiet white surface keeps the capture state and large real timer central, with source selection and the current action grouped in a compact dock.

The interface uses familiar system typography, restrained green controls, and thin dividers. A red recording indicator and track make active capture easy to recognize. The compact window keeps connection settings out of the first view until requested, and the Savia/Hefesoft attribution remains visible in the capture footer.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, single-purpose recorder with a clear Savia handoff.
Real timer and state-led Start, Stop, and Upload action.
Flat neutral surfaces with restrained green and state-specific red.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Green communicates an available or selected action; red is reserved for active recording and capture errors.

rules.name: The Timer First Rule
rules.body: Give elapsed time the strongest type scale, but keep the capture state and available action visible alongside it.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate content with spacing, tone, and fine borders; do not add ambient shadows to the utility surface.

dos: Do make the current recording state, real timer, source selection, and next action easy to identify at a glance.
Do keep microphone and system audio selection independent.
Do retain a ready recording and its upload identity after an upload error so the user can retry.
Do keep consent, privacy copy, and attribution legible in the compact window.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't place transcripts, summaries, recording history, or playback tools in this capture utility; Savia is the review surface.
Don't hide connection settings in the first view behind a large setup form.
Don't show invented waveform activity or decorate the timer with nonfunctional motion.
Don't upload captured audio before the user chooses Upload and provides the required consent.
